source.title: Reinforcing trust and security in the area of electronic communications and online services (WP2018 O.2.2.5 - Security Measures)
source.applicability: Addresses endpoint security considerations including device encryption implementation (Section 4.3), operational logging requirements (Section 5.2), and remote access security (Section 4.5) as specified in scope keyWords. Covers patching guidance (Section 4.2) and shared storage risks (Section 4.4) within the 2018 threat landscape context.

passages.text: Limited users’ privileges in operating systems
